## Jobsite Productivity Leader Acquires Construction Estimating and Payments Startup

CompanyCam expands investment in AI-driven efficiency and profitability for construction and home service trades through its acquisition of Beam

**LINCOLN, NE, March 2, 2026** – CompanyCam, which provides jobsite documentation and AI productivity tools to tens-of-thousands of construction and home service businesses, announced today its recent acquisition of Beam Finance Inc. Beam’s tools for contractors include AI estimating, payments, invoicing, and other operations and finance functions. Both companies will continue to operate independently, with CompanyCam supporting Beam’s continued early-stage growth and both companies working to better serve their mutual customers.

CompanyCam completed a Series C fundraising round in August 2025, in part to fund its long-term vision of transforming the construction industry through AI and to help contractors do good work, win the right customers, and get paid fast.

“Beam was a natural fit because they’ve built the best AI estimating and payment tools for contractors, and that’s exactly the gap we wanted to fill,” said Luke Hansen, CEO and founder of CompanyCam. ​“CompanyCam has spent 11 years helping contractors document their work in the field. Beam helps them win the job and get paid. Together, we can build something that covers the whole business.”

Both companies will continue to independently develop, market, and sell their respective platforms for the time being.

“Our teams are excited to learn from each other so that we can improve how we each serve our customers,” added Beam founder and CEO, Adam Eagle. ​“Between Beam’s expertise in construction finance and project management, and CompanyCam’s leadership in jobsite documentation and productivity, we are inspired by our combined vision for how AI will transform how construction companies build trust with their customers.”

Construction and specialty trade contractors can try both CompanyCam and Beam for free at [Com​pa​ny​Cam​.com](http://companycam.com/) or [Try​Beam​.com](http://trybeam.com/), respectively.

**About CompanyCam Inc**

CompanyCam is the leading jobsite productivity platform for contractors, helping them document jobs, communicate with crews, and share progress with clients in real time. Founded in 2015 in Lincoln, Nebraska, CompanyCam’s jobsite management tools and AI shortcuts are trusted by contractors at every phase of any project. Learn more at [com​pa​ny​cam​.com](http://companycam.com/).

**About Beam Finance Inc.**

Beam is built to automate the spreadsheets and paperwork that slow contractors down, replacing hours of manual work with systems that drive more profitable projects. The company’s platform integrates AI estimating, invoicing, payments, and project budgeting to help contractors streamline operations, improve cash flow, and gain real-time financial clarity across their projects. Learn how Beam helps contractors focus on building at [try​beam​.com](http://trybeam.com/).

## Announcing CompanyCam’s Series C Round, Led by B Capital

Series C transaction led by B Capital with participation from Decades Holdings, underscoring confidence in CompanyCam’s durable growth and vision to transform how contractors work.

**LINCOLN, NE, Aug. 21, 2025** — CompanyCam, the leading job site productivity platform with field-ready AI, today announced a new strategic growth investment from B Capital through its Series C transaction. B Capital, now CompanyCam’s largest external investor, and Decades Holdings join a distinguished group of top-tier growth investors, including Insight Partners, JMI Equity, Blueprint Equity, Nelnet, Invest Nebraska, and WndrCo.

CompanyCam’s platform replaces messy text threads, scattered paper notes, and manual photo storage with a single, real-time source of truth for every job site. Crews can capture and share project updates instantly in any language, keeping teams aligned, customers informed, and work moving forward without delays or miscommunications. This approach has made CompanyCam a trusted partner to tens of thousands of contracting businesses that depend on it to keep projects on track and communication clear.

B Capital’s significant investment reflects continued confidence in CompanyCam’s category leadership and long-term vision to transform the construction industry through its AI-powered industrial work operating system, enabling contractors to do good work, acquire the right customers, and get paid fast.

With durable ARR growth and a profitable track record, CompanyCam is poised to expand its leadership in construction technology and continue to embed AI into every workflow, deepen integrations with contractors’ existing tools, and scale its presence globally.

“We are thrilled to partner with B Capital – a firm that understands the workday realities of our contractors and brings deep expertise in AI and unique AI engineering capabilities,” said Luke Hansen, CEO of CompanyCam. ​“We share the conviction that AI will revolutionize field work and deliver the results our customers want: fewer errors, increased revenue, and most importantly, more time spent with their families.”

“With its loyal customer base of tradesmen and contractors across the country, CompanyCam has the perfect foundation to introduce more practical, time-saving AI tools to its customers. As a value-added strategic growth investor with unique AI engineering capabilities, B Capital is excited to help accelerate product development and the company’s evolution into an AI-first solution for tradesmen,” said Timur Akazhanov, General Partner at B Capital. ​“We look forward to partnering with Luke and the entire CompanyCam team to build a category-defining business and to deliver valuable solutions for customers across the industry.”

William Blair served as CompanyCam’s financial advisor for the transaction.

**About CompanyCam** CompanyCam is the leading job site productivity platform for contractors, helping them document jobs, communicate with crews, and share progress with clients in real time. Founded in 2015 in Lincoln, Nebraska, CompanyCam’s job site management tools and AI shortcuts are trusted by contractors at every phase of any project. Learn more at [com​pa​ny​cam​.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4491581-1&h=1051949456&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcompanycam.com%2F&a=companycam.com).

**About B Capital** B Capital invests globally in extraordinary founders and businesses shaping the future through technology. With more than $9 billion in assets under management and dedicated stage-based funds, the firm focuses on seed to early- and late-stage venture growth investments, primarily in the technology, healthcare, and resilience tech sectors. Founded in 2015, B Capital has an integrated, global team across nine locations in the U.S. and Asia. ## With a Two-Year Revenue Growth of 246%, CompanyCam Ranks No. 49 on Inc. Magazine’s List of the Midwest Region’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies

Companies on the 2024 Inc. 5000 Regionals: Midwest list had an average growth rate of 134.06 percent.

**LINCOLN, NE, Feb. 27, 2024 –** [_Inc._ magazine](https://www.linkedin.com/company/incmagazine/) today revealed that CompanyCam is No. 49 on its fourth annual [Inc. 5000 Regionals: Midwest](https://www.inc.com/regionals/midwest) list, the most prestigious ranking of the fastest-growing Midwest private companies, based in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, and Wisconsin. Born of the annual Inc. 5000 franchise, this regional list represents a unique look at the most successful companies within the Midwest economy’s most dynamic segment – its independent small businesses.

​“Continued growth is very important to us,” said Luke Hansen, Founder and CEO of CompanyCam. ​“But we want to be focused on impactful growth that matters for the right reasons and in the right ways. Ranking in the top third of this competitive field helps us evaluate our trajectory, and we’re happy with what we see.”

The companies on this list show a remarkable rate of growth across all industries in the Midwest region. Between 2020 and 2022, these **172 private companies** had an **average growth rate of 134.06 percent**; by 2023, they’d also added **14,830 jobs** and **$24.5 billion** to the region’s economy.

Complete results of the Inc. 5000 Regionals: Midwest, including company profiles can be found at inc​.com/​M​i​dwest starting February 27, 2024. You’ll also find an interactive database that can be sorted by industry, metro area, and other criteria.

“The honorees in our Inc. 5000 network are the Who’s Who of private companies. They’re energizing regional economies as they engineer the future of their industries. Learn who they are and what they do — they’ll be impacting things for a while,” said Eric Hagerman, Special Projects Editor at Inc. Media.

CompanyCam is a photo-based communication tool that over 170,000 contractors nationally and internationally depend on to document jobs, centralize and store project details, and quickly share visual information. Images and videos in CompanyCam are automatically stamped with the location and time, sent to the cloud, organized by project location, and available to the whole team within seconds.

**Contact: Jamie O’Donnell, 402.770.9427, jamie.​odonnell@​companycam.​com**

**More about Inc.** **and the Inc. 5000 Regionals**

**Methodology**

The 2024 Inc. 5000 Regionals are ranked according to percentage revenue growth when comparing 2020 and 2022. To qualify, companies must have been founded and generating revenue by March 31, 2020. They had to be U.S.-based, privately held, for-profit, and independent — not subsidiaries or divisions of other companies — as of December 31, 2022. (Since then, a number of companies on the list have gone public or been acquired.) The minimum revenue required for 2020 is $100,000; the minimum for 2022 is $1 million. As always, Inc. reserves the right to decline applicants for subjective reasons.

**About Inc. Media**

The world’s most trusted business-media brand, Inc. offers entrepreneurs the knowledge, tools, connections, and community to build great companies. Its award-winning multiplatform content reaches more than 50 million people each month across a variety of channels including websites, newsletters, social media, podcasts, and print. The global recognition that comes with inclusion in the 5000 gives the founders of the best businesses an opportunity to engage with an exclusive community of their peers and the credibility that helps them drive sales and recruit talent.

## CompanyCam Ranks Among Highest-Scoring Businesses on Inc. Magazine’s Annual List of Best Workplaces for 2023

CompanyCam named among best workplaces.

Lincoln, NE, May 22, 2023 — CompanyCam has been named to _Inc._ magazine’s annual Best Workplaces list. Featured in the May/​June 2023 issue, the list is the result of a comprehensive measurement of American companies that have excelled in creating exceptional workplaces and company culture.

CompanyCam is a photo-based communication tool trusted by over 140,000 contractors and pros to streamline their projects. Founded in 2015, CompanyCam has grown to over 200 employees between their Lincoln headquarters and remote locations across the country. Led by the never-a-dull-moment leadership of CEO Luke Hansen, they’ve experienced rapid growth while still prioritizing employee well-being. Their culture is anchored by their core team values — to show up, grow up, and do good — empowering employees to take work ​“the right amount of serious.”

​“I think we’ve found a good balance between working hard, and not getting burnt out,” says Hansen. ​“We’ve already hired the smartest people around, so it’s important to create an environment that makes those people want to stay.”

After collecting data from thousands of submissions, Inc. selected 591 honorees this year. Each company that was nominated took part in an employee survey, conducted by Quantum Workplace, which included topics such as management effectiveness, perks, fostering employee growth, and overall company culture. The organization’s benefits were also audited to determine overall score and ranking.

“Being named to Best Workplaces is an honor that only a small fraction of companies have been able to claim,” says Inc. editor-in-chief Scott Omelianuk. ​“Proving to the world that you’re a magnet for talent and have a culture that keeps teams engaged, productive, and proud to come to work is a truly remarkable achievement.”

**About CompanyCam**

CompanyCam is a photo-based solution that makes it easy for contractors and pros to keep track of their projects. Photos taken in CompanyCam are automatically stamped with the location and time, sent to the cloud, organized by project location, and available to the whole team. Users can add arrows, comments, drawings, and tags to add context to the photos, then add them to checklists, reports, and more to communicate effortlessly with their crews and customers.

## Roofr and CompanyCam Announce Integration Partnership

Roofr, the all-in-one sales platform for roof measurement reports and proposals, has integrated with CompanyCam.

**[Tuesday, July 12th](https://roofr.com/blog/roofr-and-companycam-announce-integration-partnership) –** Roofr, the all-in-one sales platform for roof measurement reports and proposals, has integrated with CompanyCam, the photo-based project management cloud solution for contractors.‍

The highly-demanded integration between Roofr and CompanyCam will allow users to automatically sync images, roof reports, and proposals between softwares to close deals efficiently. This integration combines the power of an on-site property visit, with the ease of digital tools for contractors to quote and close their customers.

Now, when a contractor visits a project, they can take photos that are added to a CompanyCam project, which will allow them to upload those images directly to a Roofr Proposal. They can also create Jobs in Roofr from a CompanyCam project, so when a contractor orders a Roofr Report or a Proposal gets signed by a customer, those documents are automatically synced back to their CompanyCam project.

“This integration has been highly requested from our users for quite some time. CompanyCam is a huge player in our shared industry, and we know this will create an immensely positive impact for our users”. Said Richard Nelson, CEO of Roofr. ​“We want to provide users with the best experience possible, and this integration will bring together on-site and digital solutions for contractors everywhere”.

“​We’re very excited to partner with Roofr this month. Very few integration partnerships unify the estimating, proposal and takeoff process as seamlessly as this software stack does.” Said Mike Knott, Sr Platform Partnerships at CompanyCam. ​“CompanyCam has always been the industry standard for photo and video capture, and when combined with Roofr’s estimating and proposal tools, you have everything you need to capture all the important data, out in the field, and put it together in an awesome proposal that will win our mutual customers more jobs.”
